defmodule B1dFixture.Domain do
  use Ash.Domain, validate_config_inclusion?: false

  resources do
    resource B1dFixture.Ticket
  end
end

defmodule B1dFixture.Ticket do
  # Test INPUT resource (real Ash on ETS); not generated, not shipped.
  use Ash.Resource,
    domain: B1dFixture.Domain,
    data_layer: Ash.DataLayer.Ets

  ets do
    private? false
  end

  attributes do
    uuid_primary_key :id
    attribute :title, :string, allow_nil?: false, public?: true
    attribute :state, :string, public?: true, default: "open"
  end

  actions do
    defaults [:read, :destroy]

    create :open do
      accept [:title]
    end

    create :explode do
      accept [:title]

      change fn changeset, _ctx ->
        Ash.Changeset.add_error(changeset, field: :title, message: "explode: always refuses")
      end
    end

    # Ash.Reactor requires an undo action taking a single `changeset` argument.
    destroy :undo do
      require_atomic? false
      argument :changeset, :struct, allow_nil?: false
    end

    update :close do
      change set_attribute(:state, "closed")
    end
  end
end
